brief_rationale: This trajectory demonstrates comprehensive responsibility-chain completion with no in-chain errors. The doctor screened for red flags (RC2), clarified post-surgical context (RC1), provided safe home behavior guidance (RC3), created a concrete follow-up plan (RC4), handled incomplete records (RC5), addressed privacy concerns (RC6), and obtained multiple teach-back confirmations (RC7). Two high-order points were completed: HO4 (repairing the medication confusion and clarifying prednisone discontinuation) and HO1 (balancing confidentiality with safety through limited family involvement). HO3 was partially completed with practical record guidance. The trajectory is Strong.

HO2 not triggered: The case did not require discovery of non-volunteered context such as sleep apnea significance or anesthesia evaluation status. The focus remained on current episode glucose management and ENT follow-up.
